mathematical_result.statement: For cap-one Z, gamma!=0, r real, and 1<q<2, ||p_(gamma Z^2+2rZ)||_q <= [2^(q-1)/(2-q)]^(1/q)|gamma|^(-1+1/q), sharply. Therefore the prior claimed additional affine-slope bound (2|r|)^(-1/3) is false. The exact gamma=0 external-coupling branch remains valid with ||p_Q||_infinity <= p q |b|^(-1+1/p)|c|^(-1/p), and p_Q in C_0.
mathematical_result.counterexample: Z=-r/gamma+U, U uniform[-1/2,1/2], gives gamma Z^2+2rZ=gamma U^2-r^2/gamma and attains the sharp Lq constant independently of r.

unresolved_implication: For nonzero near-null physical curvature, create smoothing while retaining the external coordinate jointly with the curved coordinate; fiberwise conditioning on the affine slope cannot supply a law-uniform improvement.
